item.title: Deadline for bobhouse removal in New Hampshire is April 1 - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: New Hampshire Fish and Game reminds bobhouse owners to remove ice shanties by April 1st. Violations can result in fines and loss of fishing privileges.

item.title: N.H. Fish and Game proposes 2026-2027 waterfowl hunting - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: New Hampshire Fish and Game Department seeks public input on proposed waterfowl hunting season dates and bag limits for 2026-2027.

item.title: Dean Kamen quits FIRST in light of ties to Jeffrey Epstein - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: Dean Kamen resigns from FIRST Robotics due to past ties with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. No misconduct found, but errors in judgment acknowledged.

item.title: Grand Monadnock Rotary Club supports transitional shelters with $5000 donation - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: The Grand Monadnock Rotary Club donated $5000 to the Eastern Monadnock Housing Security Coalition to support individuals and families in need of transitional and emergency shelters, such as gift cards for gas, grocery store gift cards, cold weather supplies, and hotel stays.

item.title: Letter challenges blame on Democrats for Trump's re-election - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: Letter challenges blame on Democrats for Trump's second term, attributing failed impeachments to Republican inaction. Republicans prioritized politics over the Constitution.

item.title: Antrim's financial health under scrutiny - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: Antrim's 2025 Town Report reveals red flags in the town's finances, raising concerns about borrowing and loan conditions.

item.title: New Hampshire's public records dispute office unstaffed - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: The state's office responsible for handling public records disputes remains vacant, leaving unresolved cases and unanswered questions.

item.title: Peterborough Woman's Club to host 1776-era program - Monadnock Ledger-Transcript
item.description: Discover the lives of women in 1776 at the Monadnock Center's 'Founding Mothers' program. Explore exhibits and enjoy refreshments. Donations support scholarships.
